description: This file defines the Prospect class, which extends the Person class and implements email capabilities, representing a prospect entity in the SuiteCRM system. It contains properties for prospect attributes, methods for building search clauses, conversion, and target retrieval, as well as integration with the larger CRM framework.

classes.name: Prospect
classes.description: Represents a prospect entity within SuiteCRM with attributes and methods for handling prospect data, search, conversion, and email functionalities.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Populates additional list view fields, including creating a proper name field and formatting email and name display.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional detail view fields, including creating a proper name field.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Constructs a flexible SQL WHERE clause for searching prospects based on a query string, matching names and phone numbers.

methods.name: converted_prospect
methods.description: Updates the prospect record to mark it as converted, linking it to contact, account, and opportunity IDs.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates whether the class implements certain interfaces, such as ACL.

methods.name: retrieveTargetList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of target entities related to prospects based on a specified query, supporting pagination and filtering.

methods.name: retrieveTarget
methods.description: Fetches a related entity based on a given ID from the prospect_lists_prospects linkage.

methods.name: get_unlinked_email_query
methods.description: Generates an SQL query to find email addresses not linked to other entities, used for email management.
